summary: Learn QGIS indicator mapping, coverage analysis and spatial reporting for programme monitoring. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: GIS mapping and spatial analysis connect programme indicators to geographic areas so monitoring teams can assess where services reach. For monitoring and evaluation officers, programme managers and data analysts, the course uses QGIS to prepare boundary data, link indicators, measure coverage and proximity, compare results across places, and create maps for field follow-up and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use programme indicators, geographic records or field data to track delivery and explain where results occur. It suits intermediate learners with some exposure to monitoring and evaluation or GIS.
modules: GIS Monitoring Brief and Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior exposure to monitoring and evaluation indicators or basic GIS concepts is recommended. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful; no programming is required. For hands-on QGIS exercises, bring a laptop with QGIS installed and, where available, programme indicator tables or spatial data suitable for practice.
